item.title: Very Important: Need decent mobile games: Re: Very Important: Need decent mobile games
item.content:encoded: Have you tried Nvidia GeForce Now? It now runs on iPhone, but you need the iOS 14. My iPhone 7 can run 14 just fine. Go to GeForce and follow the on screen instructions. Create an account and play your Steam games for free. (I recommend Destiny 2) You will need a game pad that connects to your iPhone. (An Xbox One controller or a DualShock 4)

item.title: SCP: Meme Breach: SCP: Meme Breach
item.content:encoded:
SCP: Meme Breach is a mod of SCP: Containment Breach that focuses on making the game funny as well as horrifying. Please play a little bit and feel free to make your own changes. If you do choose to build off of my project, please give credit where credit is due. Mention USfyreGaming somehow in the 'UPDATE LOG' file.
